# `kelyfos.toml` reference

Every key the parser understands, and every key it refuses on purpose.
Anything not listed here is an error naming the line — the file never
skips a key it does not recognise.

## `(bare) or [sandbox]`

What to boot, and what it may reach.

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `image` | string | "base" | image flavor to boot; refused at boot if it does not match the image's manifest |
| `arch` | string | the build host's architecture | guest architecture: aarch64 or x86_64 |
| `workspace` | string | no /work device | host directory to pack and attach at /work, resolved against this file |
| `allow` | string array | no network interface at all | egress allowlist; a bare hostname also matches its subdomains |
| `secrets` | string array | none | NAME@host[:bearer\|basic][/path] — names only; a value here is refused. A path binds the credential to that endpoint on that host exactly, instead of to the domain and every subdomain of it |
| `vcpus` | integer | 2 | pre-v0.4 spelling of a cpus default; kept working, prefer [resources] cpus |
| `mem_mib` | integer | 512 | pre-v0.4 spelling of a mem default, in MiB; prefer [resources] mem |
| `notify` | boolean | false | send a desktop notification when a run finishes, is blocked, times out, or waits for a review |

## `[resources]`

Hard ceilings for a single run, and the value when no flag asks: a flag may ask for less, never more.

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cpus` | integer | 2 cores | cores the guest sees — KVM machine config, absolute |
| `mem` | size | 512 MiB | guest RAM — KVM machine config, absolute; a bare number here is bytes, unlike --mem |
| `disk` | size | no ceiling | ceiling on the packed workspace image, refused before boot; not the /work device size |
| `scratch` | size | half the guest's RAM | size= on the tmpfs behind the overlay: everything written outside /work |
| `cpu_quota` | percentage | uncapped | host CPU time as a share of one core — cgroup v2 cpu.max, throttling |
| `net_mbps_rx` | integer | unthrottled | inbound network rate, decimal megabits — Firecracker token bucket |
| `net_mbps_tx` | integer | unthrottled | outbound network rate, decimal megabits — Firecracker token bucket |
| `disk_iops` | integer | unthrottled | operations per second, on each block device — Firecracker token bucket |
| `disk_mbps` | integer | unthrottled | bytes per second, decimal megabytes, on each block device |
| `max_runtime` | duration | no budget | wall-clock budget; expiry is SIGTERM, grace, sync-back, exit 124 |
| `idle_timeout` | duration | no budget | no tool call and no proxy traffic for this long ends the run |

## `[team]`

Several agents on one host, and the paths between them.

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | — | the team's name; required, and it names the cgroup slice |
| `record_payloads` | boolean | false | write message bodies into the record as well as their hashes |

## `[mcp]`

Limits on the outward MCP server, kelyfos serve-mcp.

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `max_sandboxes` | integer | 4 | how many sandboxes one `kelyfos serve-mcp` may have running at once |

## `[team.resources]`

The collective budget — cpu_quota is the only cap a team can share.

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cpu_quota` | percentage | no collective cap | host CPU time for the whole team — the parent cgroup slice every agent sits in |
| `cpus` | integer | 2 cores | **refused** — a per-agent cap, not a team-wide one; write it in [team.agent.resources] |
| `mem` | size | 512 MiB | **refused** — a per-agent cap, not a team-wide one; write it in [team.agent.resources] |
| `disk` | size | no ceiling | **refused** — a per-agent cap, not a team-wide one; write it in [team.agent.resources] |
| `scratch` | size | half the guest's RAM | **refused** — a per-agent cap, not a team-wide one; write it in [team.agent.resources] |
| `net_mbps_rx` | integer | unthrottled | **refused** — a per-agent cap, not a team-wide one; write it in [team.agent.resources] |
| `net_mbps_tx` | integer | unthrottled | **refused** — a per-agent cap, not a team-wide one; write it in [team.agent.resources] |
| `disk_iops` | integer | unthrottled | **refused** — a per-agent cap, not a team-wide one; write it in [team.agent.resources] |
| `disk_mbps` | integer | unthrottled | **refused** — a per-agent cap, not a team-wide one; write it in [team.agent.resources] |
| `max_runtime` | duration | no budget | **refused** — a per-agent cap, not a team-wide one; write it in [team.agent.resources] |
| `idle_timeout` | duration | no budget | **refused** — a per-agent cap, not a team-wide one; write it in [team.agent.resources] |

## `[[team.agent]]`

One agent, or count of them.

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | — | the agent's name; required, and how every other agent addresses it |
| `image` | string | the file's image, else "base" | image flavor for this agent |
| `workspace` | string | no /work device | host directory for this agent alone; refused when count is above 1 |
| `count` | integer | 1 | how many of this agent; above 1 they are named name-1 … name-N |
| `allow` | string array | no network interface at all | this agent's own egress allowlist; there is deliberately no team-wide one |
| `secrets` | string array | none | this agent's secrets; each domain must appear in this agent's allow |

## `[team.agent.resources]`

That agent's own caps: exactly the [resources] keys.

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cpus` | integer | 2 cores | cores the guest sees — KVM machine config, absolute |
| `mem` | size | 512 MiB | guest RAM — KVM machine config, absolute; a bare number here is bytes, unlike --mem |
| `disk` | size | no ceiling | ceiling on the packed workspace image, refused before boot; not the /work device size |
| `scratch` | size | half the guest's RAM | size= on the tmpfs behind the overlay: everything written outside /work |
| `cpu_quota` | percentage | uncapped | host CPU time as a share of one core — cgroup v2 cpu.max, throttling |
| `net_mbps_rx` | integer | unthrottled | inbound network rate, decimal megabits — Firecracker token bucket |
| `net_mbps_tx` | integer | unthrottled | outbound network rate, decimal megabits — Firecracker token bucket |
| `disk_iops` | integer | unthrottled | operations per second, on each block device — Firecracker token bucket |
| `disk_mbps` | integer | unthrottled | bytes per second, decimal megabytes, on each block device |
| `max_runtime` | duration | no budget | wall-clock budget; expiry is SIGTERM, grace, sync-back, exit 124 |
| `idle_timeout` | duration | no budget | no tool call and no proxy traffic for this long ends the run · **refused before boot inside a team (F-D20): a team shares one flight recorder, so the host cannot yet tell which agent went quiet — use max_runtime** |

## `[team.agent.spawn]`

The budget within which this agent may create workers at runtime.

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `max` | integer | 0, which permits no spawn | how many spawned workers this agent may have running at once |
| `image` | string array | empty, which permits nothing | image flavors a spawned worker may use; an empty list permits none, not all |
| `lifetime` | duration | no lifetime | how long a spawned worker lives before the host despawns it |

## `[team.agent.spawn.resources]`

The caps a spawned worker gets.

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cpus` | integer | 2 cores | cores the guest sees — KVM machine config, absolute |
| `mem` | size | 512 MiB | guest RAM — KVM machine config, absolute; a bare number here is bytes, unlike --mem |
| `disk` | size | no ceiling | ceiling on the packed workspace image, refused before boot; not the /work device size |
| `scratch` | size | half the guest's RAM | size= on the tmpfs behind the overlay: everything written outside /work |
| `cpu_quota` | percentage | uncapped | host CPU time as a share of one core — cgroup v2 cpu.max, throttling |
| `net_mbps_rx` | integer | unthrottled | inbound network rate, decimal megabits — Firecracker token bucket |
| `net_mbps_tx` | integer | unthrottled | outbound network rate, decimal megabits — Firecracker token bucket |
| `disk_iops` | integer | unthrottled | operations per second, on each block device — Firecracker token bucket |
| `disk_mbps` | integer | unthrottled | bytes per second, decimal megabytes, on each block device |
| `max_runtime` | duration | no budget | wall-clock budget; expiry is SIGTERM, grace, sync-back, exit 124 · **refused before boot (F-D33): this is [team.agent.spawn] lifetime under another name, and lifetime is the one that is enforced** |
| `idle_timeout` | duration | no budget | no tool call and no proxy traffic for this long ends the run · **refused before boot (F-D20, F-D33): a team shares one flight recorder, so the host cannot tell which agent went quiet — use [team.agent.spawn] lifetime** |

## `[[team.edge]]`

One permitted path; the edge list is the topology.

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `from` | string | — | the initiating agent; required. A trailing * globs over agent names |
| `to` | string | — | the addressed agent; required |
| `bidirectional` | boolean | true | whether the far end may initiate too; a reply to an ask never needs an edge |

## `[team.store]`

The permissioned key/blob store shared by the team.

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | boolean | false | whether the team has a store at all; key rules without it are inert |

## `[[team.store.key]]`

Who may read and write one key or glob.

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | — | the key or trailing-* glob this rule covers; required |
| `read` | string array | nobody, once a rule matches | agent names or globs that may read it; * is everyone |
| `write` | string array | nobody, once a rule matches | agent names or globs that may write it |

## `[[plugin]]`

One MCP server to run inside the guest; its tools are advertised as <name>_<tool>.

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | — | the plugin's name and the prefix of every tool it advertises; lowercase letters, digits and dashes, at most 24 characters |
| `path` | string | — | host directory packed into the read-only plugins device, resolved against this file |
| `command` | string | — | what the supervisor launches, resolved inside that plugin's directory |
| `args` | string array | no arguments | arguments to the command |

## `[[forward]]`

One host port carried to a guest-local port over vsock; the firewall is untouched.

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `host` | integer | — | port on this machine's loopback; --p-bind is the only way to bind anything else |
| `guest` | integer | — | guest-local port the supervisor dials on 127.0.0.1 inside the sandbox |
